subject: prd/argus
statement: When a plan is approved, Argus shall obtain its tracker materialization through the planning stage's own contract — which owns consent, idempotency, and wiring order — and shall confirm the resulting items carry the repo-configured automated-implementation tag.
rationale: the fleet bridge; materialization is the planning stage's ground — Argus triggers and confirms, never re-implements it (brainstorm:autonomous-developer#D-8, #F-8)
fit_criterion: dogfood items are created by the planning stage's materialization path, carry the configured tag, and are claimed by the fleet
